body:
## Objective

Fixes #61223

A dev container built from a local Dockerfile always ended up running as `root`, ignoring the `USER` the Dockerfile declared.

## Root cause

The generated `Dockerfile.extended` installs features as root and then restores the image's user with a trailing `USER $_DEV_CONTAINERS_IMAGE_USER` build arg. That arg was fed from inspecting the *base* image (the Dockerfile's `FROM` image), which never sees a `USER` the Dockerfile itself sets - so the trailing instruction overwrote the declared user with the base image's user (usually `root`).

This matches the reporter's differential:
- `FROM debian:trixie-slim` + `USER esp` -> base image user is empty -> falls back to `root` (bug)
- `image:` remote config -> the final image is inspected directly -> `esp` (works)

## Solution

Resolve the effective user from the Dockerfile itself and use it everywhere the image user is needed:

- New `image_user_from_dockerfile` takes the last literal `USER` instruction in the target stage (or last stage), walking back through parent stages (`FROM base AS final`) when a stage sets none, and skipping variable-based `USER` values and `\`-continued instruction bodies.
- The resolved user is stored on the manifest and used for the `_DEV_CONTAINERS_IMAGE_USER` build arg, including the Docker Compose build paths that previously hard-coded `"root"` for compose services built from a local Dockerfile or image.
- Falls back to the base image's inspected user when no stage sets one.

Note: PR #62193 by @MsfPablo also fixes this issue for plain Dockerfile builds. This PR additionally covers Docker Compose configs whose service builds from a local Dockerfile, where the same hard-coded `root` remained.

## Testing

- 11 unit tests for `image_user_from_dockerfile`: last stage, explicit target, parent-stage inheritance, child overrides parent, case-insensitive keyword, `user:group`, commented-out and continued-instruction false positives, non-literal `$` values, missing target.
- 2 integration tests run the feature-resources download phase and assert `_DEV_CONTAINERS_IMAGE_USER=esp` / `features_image_user() == "esp"` for both a plain Dockerfile config and a Docker Compose config.
- `cargo test -p dev_container`: 140 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p dev_container --all-targets`: clean.

## Self-Review Checklist

- [x] I've reviewed my own diff for quality, security, and reliability
- [x] Unsafe blocks (if any) have justifying comments
- [x] The content adheres to Zed's UI standards ([UX/UI](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#uiux-checklist) and [icon](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/main/crates/icons/README.md) guidelines)
- [x] Tests cover the new/changed behavior
- [x] Performance impact has been considered and is acceptable

---

Release Notes:

- Fixed dev containers built from a Dockerfile with a `USER` instruction running as root instead of that user.
